theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrpi_coord_plane_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (ι : Fin k → Fin P), StrictMono ι → Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P))) = k ∧ ∃ e : MultiVector P k, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, e α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf e (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P))) ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (-e) (Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P)))
